title: Imaging contract v1 (I1-I4, I8; synthetic data only, no device or DICOM qualified)

ObjectRef.description: Opaque image object reference (an original or a derived object). Never a storage path.

GrantRef.description: Opaque reference of a short-lived read grant.

PatientRef.description: Opaque patient reference owned by workstream S.

Instant.description: RFC 3339 instant with an explicit offset; stored and returned in UTC.

ReasonCode.description: Server-checked reason enumeration value; never free text.

TimeZone.description: IANA time zone name. The server also requires its zone database to know it.

Sha256.description: Lower-case hex SHA-256 of the exact object bytes.

ContentType.description: Accepted media types. The server sniffs magic bytes and never trusts a declared type or file extension. application/dicom is stored opaquely (I5 deferred; no parsing).

ObjectState.description: available: verified and servable; quarantined: retained for investigation, never served; deleted: tombstone, bytes removed.

OriginalFilename.description: Display name supplied by the uploader. Never used as a storage path; separators, control characters and dot-only names are refused.

DeviceRef.description: Placeholder device identifier (no device is qualified; I-S1).

CaptureSoftware.description: Placeholder acquisition-software code (no acquisition software is qualified; I-S1).

ProvenanceInput.description: Recorded once per ingress and never rewritten. The uploader is the authenticated actor, never a body field.

ImageObject.description: Object metadata. The storage key is internal and never returned; bytes are read only through a short-lived read grant on REST.

ttlSeconds.description: Grant lifetime; default 60 s, at most 300 s.

token.description: HMAC token bound to tenant, principal, object, grant and expiry. Sent in the x-object-read-token header with the caller's own bearer token; useless to any other principal. Never logged.

ObjectBytes.description: Raw object bytes (application/octet-stream on the wire). REST only; MCP never carries bytes.

StorageOrphanSweep.description: Orphan-bytes sweep of the caller tenant's object-store prefix. dryRun defaults to true (report only); graceHours defaults to 24 (files written more recently are never candidates).

orphans.description: Unreferenced content digests older than the grace period (removal candidates).

removed.description: Digests whose bytes this run removed (always empty in a dry run). Closeout D3: read back from the removal intents, so it includes a digest whose bytes were already gone when its intent was finished.

alreadyIntended.description: Closeout D review fix: candidates a concurrent real sweep had already committed a removal intent for (that intent finishes them; this run leaves them). Always 0 in a dry run.

pending.description: Closeout D3: this run's committed removal intents not yet finished (a later real run or a same-key retry finishes them).

resumed.description: Closeout D3: removal intents an earlier run left open that this run finished (removed, kept or reconciled as already absent).

openIntents.description: Closeout E1: removal intents open in the tenant when this sweep was recorded (before this run's own), and the age of the oldest in whole seconds on the database clock (null when none). A dry run, the scheduled report included, only reports them; a real run finishes them. Records written before Closeout E report 0 and null.

IngressRef.description: Opaque ingress session reference (staging; never an object).

ScanVerdict.description: Malware gate verdict. unknown is never clean.

intendedPatientRef.description: Patient the uploader names (scopes dedupe and becomes a match candidate); never an association by itself.

IngressBegin.description: Begin an ingress: declare the media type, exact length and SHA-256; the server checks them all again against the bytes.

ImagingWorkItem.description: Imaging work item: the same exception-first shape as the S proposed WorkItem, with imaging kinds.

PatientHints.description: Patient metadata an upload carried (for example from an acquisition-software export). Stored only as tenant-bound HMAC match keys, never as text, and never an association by itself.

ImageRef.description: Opaque, stable image handle minted at the first association (the only image identifier C stores).

inherited.description: True for a derived object, which follows its source original.

BridgePath.description: Relative bridge path resolved by the bridge inside its own import root. The server refuses traversal, absolute, drive, backslash and control-character paths (422 path_traversal) and paths outside the device allowlist (409 path_outside_import_root).

pairingCode.description: One-time pairing code, shown once; only its SHA-256 is stored. Never logged.

jobsVisible.description: Unavailable is not empty: for a device that is not available the job picture is unknown.

anyOf.description: Compact JWS (EdDSA, typ cuspatlas-bridge-job+jws) signed by the server bridge key.

result.description: Compact JWS (EdDSA, typ cuspatlas-bridge-result+jws) signed by the device key.

tables.description: Rows per exported table in foreign-key order, tenant column removed (raw column names).

blobs.description: Content-addressed manifest of the bytes of every available object.

ImagingExportDocument.description: I9 versioned imaging export (synthetic round trip; M owns the full migration contract).

ContainerInspection.description: I5 DICOM boundary (I-S2 blocked-on-discovery): marker recognition and the pinned parsing refusal. Never a summary, identifier or element.

matchesExpected.description: Always checked against the required expectedPatientRef. False when the association moved or the object is no longer available: a consumer (C15, CL-04) must not use it.

data.description: Reference read consumed by C15 and B attachment packages: a hash-bound image handle and its current association.

AnnotationRef.description: Opaque annotation reference (one lineage of versions).

MountTemplate.description: Configured mount templates (imaging-mount-templates.pending-approval.1); the number is the slot count.

mixedAssociation.description: True when slot objects are now associated with different patients (or none).

state.description: missing: the object was deleted (I8); the mount version stays readable.

Geometry.description: Normalized coordinates (0..1) over the object; never burned into the original.

AnnotationSupersede.description: With a geometry: a new version replaces the current one. Without: the annotation is withdrawn (a new version in state withdrawn).

Transform.description: Server-side transform producing a new derived object; the source is never modified. PNG sources only in this batch.

RecordClass.description: Retention record class of an image object (an original ever associated with a patient, never associated, or derived).

RetentionPolicySet.description: A new version of the retention policy of one record class. Values need legal review: every policy is recorded as recommended_pending_approval. No universal default ships.

LegalHoldPlace.description: A legal hold on one object or on every image ever associated with a patient (including identities merged into it).

bytes.description: pending: removal is retried by the next execute or reconcile.

ListScope.description: OR-01 scope: tenant-wide, the caller's assigned locations, or an explicit location set (locationRefs present for the last two).

ListEnvelope.description: OR-01 list envelope, shared by every list and worklist response.

asOf.description: Server instant the list was read.

appliedFilters.description: Normalized filters, including the defaults the server applied.

PortalReleaseCreate.description: E2: release one image to the portal of the patient it is currently associated with (human-only, audited, revocable).
